description: Fetch the Medium homepage feed (https://medium.com/?feed=<feed>). feed=for-you (default) returns the personalized recommendation stream; feed=featured returns featured stories from the publications you follow (note: despite the older 'editorial picks' meaning, the current Featured tab is empty with 'No featured stories' when you follow no publications with featured stories — the command then returns an empty list with emptyReason). Returns story cards with title, subtitle, canonical URL, author, publication, publish date text, clap/response/repost counts, preview image, member-only flag, and the 'Because you follow' topic hint. The feed lazy-loads; the command scrolls as needed up to the limit. Requires a logged-in Medium session — the For You feed is personalized and meaningless without login.

parameters.name: feed
parameters.description: Which homepage tab to read: for-you (personalized recommendations, default) | featured (featured stories from the publications YOU follow — Medium's current Featured tab semantics; returns an empty list with emptyReason when there are none, which is common). Any other value is rejected with INVALID_PARAM.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of story cards to return (1-100, default 20). The feed lazy-loads on scroll; the command scrolls until the limit is reached or the feed stops growing (then returns fewer items with partial=true). Values outside 1-100 are rejected with INVALID_PARAM.

prerequisites: Requires Chrome or Edge running with remote debugging enabled, with a logged-in Medium session. The For You feed is personalized and meaningless without login.
